environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALBv2. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override to COUNT, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in default BLOCK mode, (3) a custom rate-based rule at 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP. The target group performs health checks on /health. Additionally, the ECS task role has an attached permissions boundary that restricts outbound network to VPC-internal CIDR only (no internet egress from the container), and the task definition specifies readonlyRootFilesystem=true with a tmpfs mount only at /tmp. CloudWatch Logs Insights query runs every 60s alerting on 4xx spike patterns.

config.monitoring: CloudWatch Logs Insights 4xx anomaly detection, 60s interval
